ask: How does ZIGoals keep my data?
reply:
Your records stay on this device, in the browser. Nothing is uploaded unless you turn on encrypted sync for an account. Health syncs only after a separate opt-in.

If you do turn on encrypted sync:
- Your records are encrypted on the device before they leave.
- The server stores the encrypted data and the details it needs to deliver it. It cannot read your plans, habits or health entries.
- Signing in with an email code is not recovery. Only your recovery secret unlocks the data, so keep it somewhere safe.

Backups are optional. You can make an encrypted backup with its own secret, export a readable file per area, or use Export everything, which gives a readable ZIP.

I am your own AI, connected with your key, a local model or OpenRouter's sign-in. ZIGoals runs no AI service and sees none of this conversation. Settings → ZIGi · your AI turns me off and forgets the key.

This is from the Help notes. Would you like to know how sync or backups are set up?
